verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, a hardware processor. Serving tools to agents through an official MCP server is a software-service capability outside this product category, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows the M5 itself shipping any MCP server; the pack covers only chip performance, Metal and Core ML APIs, and hardware specs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
